GRANT OF PERMANENT UTILITY EASEMENT

THIS GRANT OF PERMANENT UTILITY EASEMENT (this "Easement") is made as of October 9, 2026, by AUGUSTINE HOLLOW FARMS, LLC, an Oregon limited liability company, whose address is 41200 Wapato Creek Road, Sheridan, Oregon 97378 ("Grantor"), in favor of YAMHILL VALLEY WATER DISTRICT, an Oregon special district, whose address is 118 Court Street, McMinnville, Oregon 97128 ("Grantee").

RECITALS

A. Grantor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property in Yamhill County, Oregon, more particularly described on Exhibit A (the "Servient Estate").

B. Grantee owns and operates a municipal water system and requires a permanent easement across a portion of the Servient Estate to construct, operate, and maintain a 24-inch transmission main.

C. Grantor is willing to grant the easement on the terms below.

NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, Grantor agrees as follows.

1. Grant.

Grantor hereby grants, bargains, sells, and conveys to Grantee, its successors and assigns, a permanent, non-exclusive easement (the "Easement Area") over, under, upon, and across that portion of the Servient Estate described and depicted on Exhibit B, being a strip twenty (20) feet in width, together with the rights described in Section 2. TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the same unto Grantee and its successors and assigns forever.

2. Permitted Uses.

Grantee may use the Easement Area to construct, install, inspect, operate, maintain, repair, replace, enlarge, and remove one water transmission main and appurtenant valves, meters, air-release assemblies, cathodic protection, and markers, together with the right of ingress and egress over the Servient Estate by the existing farm road shown on Exhibit B for those purposes. Grantee may cut and remove trees, brush, and other vegetation within the Easement Area that interfere with the facilities.

3. Reserved Rights of Grantor.

Grantor reserves the right to use the Easement Area for any purpose not inconsistent with this Easement, including cultivation, grazing, and the crossing of the Easement Area by farm equipment and by roads and utilities installed at approximately right angles and at a depth or height that does not interfere with the facilities. Grantor shall not, within the Easement Area, erect any building or permanent structure, plant any tree, impound water, change the ground elevation by more than one foot, or store equipment or materials, in each case without Grantee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

4. Restoration.

After any entry, Grantee shall promptly restore the surface of the Easement Area and any other portion of the Servient Estate disturbed by Grantee to a condition as near as reasonably practicable to its condition before the entry, including regrading, replacing topsoil, reseeding, and repairing fences, drain tile, and irrigation lines. Grantee shall compensate Grantor for growing crops actually damaged, valued at the county extension service's published average yield and the commodity price on the date of damage.

5. Maintenance and Standard of Work.

Grantee shall maintain the facilities in good repair at its sole expense, and shall perform all work in a good and workmanlike manner in compliance with applicable law. Grantee shall give Grantor at least ten (10) days' prior written notice before any non-emergency entry, and shall give notice as soon as practicable after any emergency entry.

6. Indemnity.

Grantee shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Grantor from and against any claim, loss, liability, or expense, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of Grantee's use of the Easement Area or the acts or omissions of Grantee, its employees, agents, or contractors, except to the extent caused by Grantor's negligence or willful misconduct. Grantee's obligation is subject to the limitations of the Oregon Tort Claims Act, ORS 30.260 to 30.300, and nothing in this Easement waives any immunity or limitation available to Grantee under that Act.

7. Insurance.

Grantee shall maintain, or shall require its contractors to maintain, commercial general liability insurance covering work in the Easement Area with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 in the aggregate, naming Grantor as an additional insured, and shall furnish a certificate of insurance on Grantor's request.

8. Runs with the Land.

This Easement is appurtenant to Grantee's water system, runs with the land, and binds and benefits Grantor and Grantee and their respective heirs, successors, and assigns. This Easement shall be recorded in the Deed Records of Yamhill County, Oregon.

9. Abandonment.

If Grantee permanently ceases to use the Easement Area for the purposes stated in Section 2 for a continuous period of five (5) years, the Easement terminates automatically, and Grantee shall, within ninety (90) days after written request, execute and record an instrument of release in recordable form. Non-use during a period of repair, replacement, or seasonal inactivity is not abandonment.

10. Warranty of Title.

Grantor covenants that Grantor is lawfully seized of the Servient Estate in fee simple, has good right to grant this Easement, and will warrant and defend the Easement against the lawful claims of all persons claiming by, through, or under Grantor.

11. Governing Law; Entire Agreement; Counterparts.

This Easement is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles, and venue for any action lies in the Circuit Court for Yamhill County, Oregon. This Easement is the entire agreement of the parties concerning its subject matter and may be amended only by a recorded instrument signed by both parties. It may be executed in counterparts.

BEFORE SIGNING OR ACCEPTING THIS INSTRUMENT, THE PERSON TRANSFERRING FEE TITLE SHOULD INQUIRE ABOUT THE PERSON'S RIGHTS, IF ANY, UNDER ORS 195.300, 195.301 AND 195.305 TO 195.336 AND SECTIONS 5 TO 11, CHAPTER 424, OREGON LAWS 2007, SECTIONS 2 TO 9 AND 17, CHAPTER 855, OREGON LAWS 2009, AND SECTIONS 2 TO 7, CHAPTER 8, OREGON LAWS 2010.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, Grantor has executed this Easement as of the date first written above.
